description: One-time acceptance of the Widely Errands terms, needed before any AI call or errand can dial. Without confirm it returns a short terms summary, the link to the full terms, and whether this user already accepted. Show that to the user; only after the user clearly agrees, call again with confirm=true to record the acceptance. Safe to repeat.

confirm.description: true only after the user has agreed to the terms shown.
